policy_binding.applicable_rule: All mandatory planning checks must pass; reference/source fidelity at least9.9 with no averaging. Exact10 is used only where every applicable content/source comparison passed. No visual or task closure is inferred.

mandatory_checks.name: Exact owner scope and 10×50 mapping
mandatory_checks.evidence: Ten worlds, local1–50 each,500 planned positions; actual count instruction retained; T12/T32 and T44–T52 correctly mapped.

mandatory_checks.name: Release and identity boundary
mandatory_checks.evidence: World1 release and later connected updates remain distinct; world/local identity and ordinal are proposed; UI/save migration remains unimplemented.

mandatory_checks.name: Authentic task preservation
mandatory_checks.evidence: All70 graph names/dependency arrays/status snapshots match independent source comparison; T71–T80 remain undefined; no task activation or ownership change.

mandatory_checks.name: Historical record preservation
mandatory_checks.evidence: 29 unaffected table rows,70 migration states,two history sections and prior13-file candidate manifest remain preserved.

mandatory_checks.name: Source custody and precedence
mandatory_checks.evidence: 50/50 local source SHA-256 and Git blob hashes match; six pinned GitHub source file identities verified; owner quotes retained; staged bytes not falsely called main-published.

mandatory_checks.name: Production and upgrade value scope
mandatory_checks.evidence: Substantial visual change, actual I/O/working hardware, conserved stock, attainable bills, bottlenecks and useful measured benefit required; no fake rates/yields/skins-per-level.

mandatory_checks.name: Storage-house semantics
mandatory_checks.evidence: Storage explicitly included. Existing actor unlimited carrying is separated from warehouse storage contract; real handling/routing/resilience value is required; no invented capacity sale.

mandatory_checks.name: Defense, survivors and pets
mandatory_checks.evidence: Fence/tower attack/defense and actor capability improvements required. Simultaneous living actors, jobs/targets/reservations/budgets/recall/casualty/save continuity are explicit.

mandatory_checks.name: Numeric policy and geometry boundaries
mandatory_checks.evidence: Prior3-pet/2-escort source retained as unintegrated starting policy; no new cap/unlock approval. Upgraded geometry/ports may expand with mapped function/cost/clearances while unit scale and gates remain protected.

mandatory_checks.name: Vehicle conflict handling
mandatory_checks.evidence: Low fuel requirement is carried forward; partial versus whole-load unloading and in-camp blade exception conflict remain explicit, without falsely choosing one or changing runtime.

mandatory_checks.name: Migration and acceptance completeness
mandatory_checks.evidence: Actual100/99 validators, ten-level bands and dynamic economy risk are named. Preserved saves/quotes/recovery and release-gate reconciliation remain required; no500-outcome/native/shipping claim.
